selection: Existing ensure_text_buffer constructs an owned TextBufferKey before lookup, cloning plain/rich strings even on hits. Source inspection establishes avoidable work; no benchmark or numerical speedup claim.
production_paths: General frame/workspace/terminal text: Renderer::render_with_submission -> TextBufferCache::begin_frame(Workspace) -> indices -> glyphon prepare
General menu and dialog text: Renderer::prepare_overlay_text -> same TextBufferCache::indices
Dialog-only frames: Renderer::render_overlay_only -> begin_frame(Overlay) -> prepare_overlay_text -> trim_overlay
competing_paths_retired: Renderer-owned raw cache vector and separately mutable frame counter
Renderer-specific cache lifecycle and ensure helpers
Unconditional owned-key construction for warm cache hits
change: TextBufferCache owns entries and frame age. Borrowed lookup compares every existing key field; extent computed once per run, owned strings constructed only for a miss. Existing shaping APIs, glyph preparation signatures, cache profile semantics, shaders and render passes remain.
bounds: Workspace/terminal retains current/previous generations. Overlay retains at most 128 buffers and 32 KiB of key strings after submission. These are existing entry/key bounds, not complete shaped-payload/atlas/capacity bounds.
